subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should `skills.workshop.approvalPolicy: "auto"` remain absolute for every valid update, or may low-confidence replacement updates force a one-time explicit approval?
rationale: The PR intentionally narrows a recent maintainer-authored approval default; source review identifies the safety tradeoff but cannot determine the permanent operator-policy contract without owner intent.

options.title: Gate low-retention replacements
options.body: Keep ordinary updates automatic, but require explicit approval whenever retained meaningful content is below a robust threshold rather than only when overlap is exactly zero.

options.title: Keep auto absolute
options.body: Do not override the configured automatic policy; instead reject deterministically invalid proposal bodies and require intentional complete replacements through another explicit operator surface.

recommendation.title: Gate low-retention replacements
recommendation.body: Keep ordinary updates automatic, but require explicit approval whenever retained meaningful content is below a robust threshold rather than only when overlap is exactly zero.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current automatic lifecycle-approval default that the PR proposes to qualify.
